github._comment: repos: [] = all non-archived org repos. For GitHub Enterprise set apiBaseUrl to https://<ghe-host>/api/v3.

jira._comment: Map YOUR board's exact status names into these phases. Email + token come from JIRA_EMAIL / JIRA_API_TOKEN env vars, never this file.

failure._comment: Reverts are auto-detected from PR titles/branches. Add your hotfix conventions here.
